prompts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / precise-object-edit.
Edit the supplied approved snowfield female mercenary illustration. Output ONE finished native 1024x1536 RGB PNG, exact 2:3 portrait.
This is a tightly scoped weapon-and-hair edit. Preserve the SAME adult woman: exactly the existing face structure, eyes, nose, lips, expression, straight wispy fringe, long dark chestnut hair, head size and angle; preserve her slightly slender figure and long legs, all clothing, short skirt, boots, ivory/champagne-gold palette, snowy fortress background, camera distance and premium semi-realistic 2D game-painting finish. The user has specifically approved the FACE, SNOW CONCEPT and COSTUME. Do not redesign or beautify those.

WEAPON CHANGE:
Completely remove the one long assault rifle and replace it with EXACTLY TWO matching compact fantasy SUBMACHINE GUNS, one independently held in each hand. They must unmistakably be compact SMGs, not two pistols or full-length rifles: short substantial receivers, compact barrel shrouds, distinct short magazines, folded/slim skeleton shoulder stocks, separate ergonomic pistol grips. Design coherent ivory-white and champagne-gold exterior armor with dark graphite internals to match the existing outfit and old rifle's finish. Each complete weapon is about the length of her forearm, not tiny. Both guns visible and fully separated; no third gun, no long rifle remaining, no duplicated hands, no floating attachments, no writing.
Adjust ONLY shoulders, elbows and hands as needed for a natural poised dual-wield stance. One bent arm holds its SMG beside the torso with the barrel raised slightly outward; the other hand holds its SMG low beside the other hip, muzzle angled down and away. Leave the face, chest and long leg silhouettes readable. Realistic wrist alignment, five anatomically coherent fingers per hand, both palms actually wrapped around their own gun's pistol grip. No firing or muzzle flash.

HAIR CORRECTION:
Preserve her haircut, fringe, color, length and natural volume, but replace the many sharply separated ribbon-like windblown layers with soft natural continuous hair flowing gently behind her shoulders. Root-to-tip continuity, smoothly merging masses, subtle individual strands and fine flyaways, gradual soft highlights. The hair should feel like real soft hair translated into painterly 2D illustration. No plate/strip layers, blade-shaped chunks, hard repeated tier contours, disconnected hair ribbons, metallic bands, plastic shine or excessive wind. 자연스러운 연속 모발 흐름 / 층층이 갈라진 판·띠형 헤어 금지.

Keep the original long/slender natural adult anatomy and exact short skirt design. Keep all visible clothing opaque. Preserve original image quality and composition instead of zooming or cropping. Both feet and both complete SMGs fit in the portrait, with room for a separate card frame. No text, letters, logo, watermark, UI, frame, montage, extra person, photorealistic cosplay, plastic 3D or chibi.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept with strict adult character facial identity preservation.
Create ONE entirely new finished source-art illustration of JOEUN for a LIMITED mercenary in Soopketmon PROJECT V. Native 1024x1536 RGB PNG, exact 2:3 portrait. One adult woman in a striking black-and-white neon special-forces uniform wielding ONE enormous futuristic HEAVY LASER CANNON inspired by Dungeon & Fighter's Launcher fantasy. This is a new composition, not an edit of the earlier rejected neon-rifle designs.

REFERENCE ROLES, IN EXACT ORDER:
1. Duo photograph: ONLY THE ADULT WOMAN ON THE RIGHT is Joeun, the primary real facial-identity reference. Preserve her actual softly elongated oval face, natural jaw and chin width, almond brown eye shapes and spacing, eyelids, brows, nose bridge/tip, and characteristic full lips. Do not mix in the left woman's face. Do NOT enlarge the eyes, shrink the jaw, sharpen or miniaturize the nose, or replace her with a generic pretty anime woman. The image supplies face identity, NOT the leaning-back tilted head, chin pose, red gown or background. She must be recognizable in a new upright head position and new standing pose.
2. Approved NURSE JOEUN illustration: this is the SAME named character's established illustration reference. Study its gentle recognizable facial impression and refined painted facial planes as a bridge from the photograph to the project's game-art look. Keep the identity consistent, subject to the photograph's real facial structure. No nurse cap, cross, stethoscope, outfit, kneeling pose, face tilt, or broad plastic hair highlights.
3. Approved POLICE JOEUN illustration: the SAME character's mercenary continuity and soft natural long dark hair; use her facial expression/finish to keep Joeun recognizable. Do not reproduce that pose, blue police shirt, tie or pistol.
4. LOTTE JOEUN avatar: ONLY natural slender adult body and elegant long leg proportions; no copied face, cream/burgundy uniform, ponytail, crest, or palace.
5. Vespera: ONLY the polished high-end painterly 2D fantasy splash-art style, face readability and convincing material differentiation. Do not copy Vespera's face, short hair, red costume, glasses, stance or scenery.

JOEUN / HAIR:
A confident composed adult Joeun with the above unchanged facial structure, head upright, chin naturally level, looking toward the viewer while torso angles slightly toward the heavy cannon. New unforced expression with gently closed lips. Long natural dark brown-black side-parted hair, face unobstructed, softly falling over/behind shoulders. Continuous soft root-to-tip hair flow, low wind, gradual shading, fine strands and a few flyaways. No stepped layers, separated flat ribbons, hard blade-like chunks, big disconnected waves, metallic/plastic bands. 자연스러운 연속 모발 흐름 / 층층이 갈라진 판·띠형 헤어 금지.

OUTFIT / ANATOMY:
Redesign the black-white special-forces uniform from scratch. A fitted opaque pearl-white short-sleeve tactical jacket with a clean tailored collar and graphite side panels, shaped to the waist without a corset or cropped exposed midriff. A restrained asymmetric white armor panel on the weapon-support shoulder, small cyan luminous seams integrated into the equipment, compact forearm support and slim dark gloves. Separate high-waisted fitted BLACK SHORT MINISKIRT with a clean upper-thigh hem and narrow white edging; no trousers or shorts or long skirt. Long natural slender legs, balanced adult hips and torso, no pinhead or giant head, no exaggerated tiny waist. Sleek black calf-high combat boots with white structural details and grounded modest soles. Avoid bulky leg armor, cluttered thigh straps and dangling fabric. Outfit tailoring must look distinctly newly designed, not a recolored nurse or avatar uniform.

HEAVY LASER CANNON:
ONE physically imposing shoulder/hip-supported heavy energy artillery weapon; evoke DNF Launcher's oversized charged Laser Rifle heavy-weapon presence. NOT an ordinary assault rifle, sniper rifle, thin railgun, dual gun, gatling, or missile launcher. A broad thick cylindrical/rectangular hybrid cannon housing with a huge recessed circular lens muzzle, substantial pearl-white protective armor, graphite inner chassis, large integrated cyan energy chamber, coherent heat-sink blocks and a few restrained violet accents. The cannon's housing thickness is approximately the width of her upper torso; its overall length approximately her torso plus one forearm. A substantial, intentionally designed handheld sci-fi artillery silhouette, with clean organized shapes rather than a pile of small mechanisms. Cyan charged light deep inside the muzzle and energy core, restrained atmospheric bloom; no giant beam covering the character, no text, scope, normal rifle magazine or tiny gun barrel.
She braces it convincingly across her lower torso, the rear support close to her hip/upper arm, firing hand wrapped around the rear pistol grip, support hand visibly gripping a solid forward underside handle. Naturally bent elbows and correctly connected shoulders/wrists, no detached palm. Muzzle angled toward the lower-left of the image, clear of the legs and face; entire main cannon silhouette visible, not cropped. Stance offset with weight on the rear leg and one foot a small step forward, knees natural, both feet grounded. The weight and size should read immediately, while her face remains the focal point.

COMPOSITION / SCENE:
Purposeful full-figure portrait with camera near her torso height, natural perspective, clearly readable face near the upper fifth, both boots visible with small safe margins. Avoid the photograph's head tilt or chin-resting pose; avoid frontal mannequin posture. A rain-damp military skybridge / neon power-station platform at blue hour, distant industrial-fantasy architecture and soft cyan reflected lights. Background subordinate and atmospheric, no signs or extra people. Soft neutral light on her face preserves identity, restrained cool rim light on black-white equipment; no face obscured by cyan glow.

FINISH:
High-end character-centered SEMI-REALISTIC FANTASY SPLASH ART, refined 2D Korean collectible-game painting, same premium finish as established Joeun mercenaries and Vespera. Painterly skin, cloth, hair and ceramic/metal material separation, natural adult anatomy and coherent hands. Not photoreal cosplay, Western realistic RPG, plastic 3D, generic anime face, cel shading, or chibi. No text, rank, SS letters, character name, logo, signature, watermark, UI, card frame, inset or montage.
